data.body: Session 2026-05-12: Ran build-review-agents.sh to regenerate all 10 code-reviewer-*.md agents from reviewer-base.md (added tier-aware caller-input verification gate). The agents are regenerated correctly, but the underlying copy-paste duplication of the context-request protocol across reviewer files was not consolidated — each agent still embeds its own copy. Root issue remains; regeneration keeps copies in sync but doesn't reduce the duplication.
